description: The University of Tsukuba publishes early suspended-radiocesium measurements collected by the Fukushima Prefectural Center for Environmental Creation. The ERAN landing page describes 134Cs and 137Cs concentrations at 29 river sites within 80 km of Fukushima Daiichi, together with median particle diameter and specific surface area. Coverage runs from 27 June 2011 to 15 January 2012, with irregular sample intervals averaging 35 days. Concentrations are decay-corrected to each collection date. The delimited data are freely linked from the repository under CC BY 4.0. They can calibrate sediment-associated contamination transport and water-infrastructure exposure simulations, including transport calculations constructed with model-openfoam. A caveat is that suspended measurements do not directly quantify dissolved contamination or drinking-water concentrations. Sampling frequency varies, and laboratory preparation affects interpretation of particle properties. This deposit alone does not provide continuous coverage for all six years discussed by the later descriptor. No measurements were downloaded.
